description: Header file defining internal big integer class and constants used for decimal-to-binary conversions in the Abseil library.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: A fixed-width big integer class used for precise decimal-to-binary conversions, supporting operations like multiplication, shifting, and comparison.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two BigUnsigned instances, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two BigUnsigned instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two BigUnsigned instances.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is less than another.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is greater than another.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is greater than or equal to another.
